scenes.narrationText: Every Teams sign-in starts with one question: who are you, and how do we know?
scenes.notes: Animated editorial title, identity assembly, proof-line draw, and verification reveal.

scenes.narrationText: Teams supports every identity model Microsoft 365 does - and it really comes down to two.
scenes.notes: The request appears first, then each branch draws and its identity model pops into place.

scenes.narrationText: First, cloud-only. Accounts live in Microsoft Entra ID, which handles sign-in in the cloud.
scenes.notes: Cloud boundary draws, the account appears, the sign-in route draws, and verification lands.

scenes.narrationText: Second, hybrid. Accounts are managed in your on-premises Active Directory and synced up with Microsoft Entra Connect. Credentials get validated by Entra ID, AD DS, or a federated provider.
scenes.notes: AD, Connect, and Entra appear in order as both routes draw; validation choices reveal sequentially.

scenes.narrationText: Passwords are the weak link, so add multifactor authentication: a code, a call, or Microsoft Authenticator.
scenes.notes: Password appears, the broken route draws, MFA lands, then code, call, and Authenticator pop in sequence.

scenes.narrationText: Start with admin accounts. Then roll it out to everyone.
scenes.notes: Admin bubble enters left, arrow draws right, then the blue everyone bubble appears using the same approved Fluent people glyph.
Original supplied Microsoft 365 Copilot end-card animation, played full-frame with its native audio intentionally muted.
